The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

Here is the adjusted email, rewritten to be more professional, constructive, and encouraging while maintaining the necessary boundary regarding the budget denial:

Subject: Update on Your Department’s Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase for your department. We appreciate the effort you put into outlining your needs.

After careful review, we are unable to approve the request at this time, as the current justification does not fully align with the company’s immediate financial strategy. However, we are open to reconsidering this in the future.

If you would like to resubmit the request, please provide a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. This additional context will help us better understand the value and impact of the proposed increase.

Please let me know if you have any questions or if you would like to discuss this further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
